title.narrative: Martin Ennals Foundation CSF 07-22 YR 1 payment for Strengthening Human Rights

description.narrative: The ‘Enhancing Human Rights Defenders Protection and Advocacy: 2019-2021’ project aims to provide special protection ("protective publicity") to human rights defenders who are at risk by focusing international media attention on their plight, mainly through the internet, particularly in their country of origin. The main objective is to honour and protect individuals around the world who demonstrate exceptional courage in defending and promoting human rights. The key activity is an awards ceremony which recognises three finalists, including one laureate. Finalists to the Award and the Laureate are selected by a Jury of ten of the world’s leading human rights NGOs. While the award focuses on three individuals, the media attention highlights wider human rights concerns in the countries concerned. All three finalists are given the opportunity to increase their international work through international advocacy trips.
